title: Return to Ravnica/Event decks
description: MTG Wiki (Category:Return to Ravnica block event decks)

paragraphs.text: Return to Ravnica has two bicolored guild -centric event decks .
Golgari: Creep and Conquer is a black / green event deck representing the Golgari Swarm .
The rares in this deck are Grim Backwoods , Woodland Cemetery , Deadbridge Goliath , Disciple of Bolas , Ulvenwald Tracker , Wolfir Silverheart , and Thragtusk .
Rakdos: Wrack and Rage is a black / red event deck that representing the Cult of Rakdos .
The rares in this deck are Dragonskull Summit , Stromkirk Noble , Stromkirk Noble , Devil's Play , Mizzium Mortars , Grafdigger's Cage , and Vexing Devil .
